outcome: Absence of vascular masses on subsequent ultrasound follow-ups
cohort: A 29-year-old woman, gravida 5, para 1, presenting with lower abdominal pain and intermittent vaginal bleeding due to uterine arteriovenous malformation, with a history of one cesarean section and four artificial abortions.
finding: Hysteroscopic roller ablation successfully treated uterine arteriovenous malformation in this patient, leading to smooth recovery and resolution of the vascular masses on follow-up.
